# telnyx_telephony_credential (Data Source)

A credential that WebRTC clients use to sign in to a credential connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `expired` (Boolean) Defaults to false
- `expires_at` (String) ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the resource will expire.
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `resource_id` (String) Identifies the resource this credential is associated with.
- `sip_password` (String, Sensitive) The randomly generated SIP password for the credential.
- `sip_username` (String) The randomly generated SIP username for the credential.
- `token_material` (Attributes, Sensitive) What a server needs to mint login tokens for the credential itself, with no request per token (`TelephonyCredential#to_jwt` in telnyx-ruby 3.1.0 or later). As sensitive as `sip_password`: keep it on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_material))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO-8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user this credential is associated with.

<a id="nestedatt--token_material"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_material`

Read-Only:

- `kid` (String) Identifies the Telnyx signing key the `signing_secret` was derived with. Goes in the token header.
- `signing_secret` (String) The HMAC-SHA256 key the token is signed with, base64url without padding.
- `tel_token` (String) Opaque value Telnyx uses to resolve the credential. Carried in the token's `tel_token` claim as is.
